mcq.q: Percussion instruments make sound when they are
options: bowed with a stick of hair
mcq.explanation: A percussion instrument is played by hitting, shaking or scraping it.

mcq.q: What does the word indigenous mean?
options: Belonging to a people and place from long ago
mcq.explanation: Indigenous instruments belong to a community and were made from local materials.

mcq.q: If you tighten the skin of a drum, the sound becomes
mcq.explanation: A tighter skin vibrates faster and gives a higher sound.

mcq.q: Which is a non-melodic percussion instrument?
mcq.explanation: A shaker gives a rattling sound but not different notes for a tune.

mcq.q: To improvise a rhythmic pattern means to
options: copy it from a book only
make it up on the spot
mcq.explanation: Improvising is inventing a pattern without preparing it first.

mcq.q: What is the correct order for making charcoal sticks?
mcq.explanation: The stages are cutting, trimming, burning, then cooling.

mcq.q: Smudging a charcoal drawing means
options: rubbing it gently so the tones blend
mcq.explanation: Smudging spreads the charcoal so that light and dark blend smoothly.

mcq.q: A gourd rattle makes sound because
options: the seeds inside knock against the walls
mcq.explanation: When shaken, seeds inside hit the gourd and make a sound.

mcq.q: What is the length of a full netball court?
mcq.explanation: A full court is 30.5 metres long and 15.25 metres wide.

mcq.q: Which position takes the centre pass to start the game?
mcq.explanation: The Centre takes the centre pass.

mcq.q: How long may a player hold the ball before passing or shooting?
mcq.explanation: A player must pass or shoot within three seconds.

mcq.q: What is the correct way to catch a netball?
options: With two hands, giving with the ball
mcq.explanation: A double-handed catch with elbows bending as the ball arrives is correct.

mcq.q: When is an overhead pass most useful?
options: When you are alone on the court
When a defender is standing close
mcq.explanation: The ball goes over the defender's arms.

mcq.q: The first step of tying an overhand knot is to
mcq.explanation: You make a loop first, pass the end through it and pull tight.

mcq.q: Which is true about netball skills?
options: Only the umpire needs to pass
Passing and catching are needed by every player
mcq.explanation: Every player passes and catches during a game.

mcq.q: Yellow mixed with blue makes
mcq.explanation: Yellow and blue give green.

mcq.q: Why is colour classification useful in painting?
options: It tells us which colours to mix to make others
mcq.explanation: Knowing primary and secondary colours helps us mix what we need.

mcq.q: A darker tone of a colour is called a
mcq.explanation: Adding black makes a shade.

mcq.q: Where do you place a soft shadow when painting a fruit on a table?
options: On the table under the fruit
mcq.explanation: A shadow under the object makes it seem to sit on the table.

mcq.q: A montage is
options: a picture made by joining many cut pieces on a background
a painting with only one colour
mcq.explanation: A montage joins many pictures or pieces to make one whole picture.

mcq.q: Where can you get pictures for a montage?
mcq.explanation: Cut pictures from old papers and magazines.

mcq.q: Which is the first step in mixing green?
options: Put red and black on the palette
Put yellow and blue on the palette
mcq.explanation: Green comes from yellow and blue.

mcq.q: Rhythm is
options: the pattern of long and short sounds
mcq.explanation: Rhythm is the pattern of sounds over the beat.

mcq.q: A pair of quavers together lasts
mcq.explanation: Two half beats make one whole beat.

mcq.q: How long does a quaver rest last?
mcq.explanation: A quaver rest is half a beat of silence.

mcq.q: How many claps are there in the pattern ta-te ta-te taa (rest)?
mcq.explanation: Ta-te has two, ta-te has two, taa has one, and the rest has none, so five claps.

mcq.q: Which letter has a descender?
mcq.explanation: The tail of g goes below the baseline.

mcq.q: Why is a pattern with only taa taa taa taa dull?
options: It has no variation of note values
mcq.explanation: A good pattern mixes different note values.

mcq.q: What is a critique?
options: An honest, kind talk about someone's work
mcq.explanation: A critique gives fair comments in a respectful way.

mcq.q: A melody is
mcq.explanation: A melody is a series of notes that make a tune.

mcq.q: Which is the lowest of the notes d, r and m?
mcq.explanation: Doh is the lowest of the three.

mcq.q: The Kodaly hand sign for r is
mcq.explanation: Ray is a palm that slopes upward.

mcq.q: A well known children's song that uses only m r d is
mcq.explanation: Hot Cross Buns uses only three notes.

mcq.q: Variation in a melody means using
mcq.explanation: Variation makes a tune interesting.

mcq.q: How many notes are in the melody d r m m r d?
mcq.explanation: Count d, r, m, m, r, d to get six.

mcq.q: A coil of clay is
options: a long thin roll like a snake
mcq.explanation: A coil is a long, thin, even roll of clay.

mcq.q: How many rectangular slabs of different sizes are cut in this lesson?
mcq.explanation: Three slabs are cut, one for each of d, r and m.

mcq.q: What is the first command at the start of a race?
mcq.explanation: The starter first says on your marks.

mcq.q: Compared with the medium start, the elongated start has the back knee
mcq.explanation: Elongated means longer, so the feet are further apart.

mcq.q: In a good sprinting technique, the elbows are bent to about
mcq.explanation: Bent arms swinging back and forth help the stride.

mcq.q: Where should you stay during a sprint race?
options: On the grass beside the track
mcq.explanation: Running in your lane prevents crashes.

mcq.q: The middle stripe of the Kenyan flag is
mcq.explanation: Red is the middle stripe.

mcq.q: On the Kenyan flag, white stands for
mcq.explanation: White stands for peace and honesty.

mcq.q: What is patriotism?
mcq.explanation: Patriotism is love and respect for one's country.

mcq.q: In a crab balance, your body is supported by
mcq.explanation: A crab balance rests on two hands and two feet.

mcq.q: In a crab balance, what is a common mistake?
mcq.explanation: Hips should stay lifted to make the body level.

mcq.q: At the start of the side roll, your arms are
mcq.explanation: Arms overhead with palms together keep the body long.

mcq.q: Which should you remove before gymnastics?
mcq.explanation: Jewellery can hurt you or others.

mcq.q: A good sequence has
options: a clear start, smooth middle and controlled finish
mcq.explanation: Good sequences are planned and controlled.

mcq.q: How does gymnastics help the heart and lungs?
options: Moving the whole body makes the heart beat faster and stay strong
mcq.explanation: Active movement strengthens the heart and lungs.

mcq.q: If your head drops back with a strain in the crab balance, you should
options: keep the head in line and look gently up
mcq.explanation: Keep the head in line with the body.

mcq.q: A patriotic song shows
mcq.explanation: Patriotic songs celebrate the nation.

mcq.q: The mood of a song is
mcq.explanation: Mood is the feeling of a song, such as joy or calm.

mcq.q: In music, the sign f means
mcq.explanation: The letter f stands for loud.

mcq.q: What does good diction mean?
mcq.explanation: Clear words help the audience understand the message.

mcq.q: Which is good etiquette for a performer?
options: Walk on and off the stage quietly
mcq.explanation: Good manners show respect for the audience and others.

mcq.q: How should you behave when the anthem is sung?
mcq.explanation: An anthem is sung with respect.

mcq.q: Which folk songs are sung when young people become adults in their community?
mcq.explanation: Initiation songs mark the change from child to adult.

mcq.q: Photography is
options: the art of taking pictures with a camera
mcq.explanation: A photograph is a picture taken by a camera.

mcq.q: The lens of a camera
mcq.explanation: The lens gathers light for the picture.

mcq.q: How should you clean the lens of a camera?
mcq.explanation: A soft cloth cleans without scratching.

mcq.q: Where must you never take photographs?
options: In private places such as toilets
mcq.explanation: Privacy must be respected.

mcq.q: For a well-lit photograph of a person, the sun should be
mcq.explanation: Light falls on the front of the subject.

mcq.q: The centre of interest is
options: the main thing you want people to notice
mcq.explanation: It draws the eye first.

mcq.q: A blurred photograph is
mcq.explanation: Blurred means not sharp.

mcq.q: Before sharing a photograph of others, you should
mcq.explanation: Respect and safety come first.

mcq.q: How many joints does a descant recorder have?
mcq.explanation: Head joint, middle joint and foot joint.

mcq.q: Where is the thumb hole?
mcq.explanation: The left thumb covers the hole at the back.

mcq.q: How should you hold the recorder?
options: Pointing down and away from your body at an angle
mcq.explanation: The recorder is held pointing down at about 45 degrees.

mcq.q: For a good tone you should blow
options: with your cheeks puffed for ever
mcq.explanation: A gentle, steady breath gives a warm tone.

mcq.q: Why keep a recorder away from strong sun and fire?
mcq.explanation: Heat can warp or crack the instrument.

mcq.q: Of the notes B, A and G, which is the lowest?
mcq.explanation: More holes covered gives a lower note.

mcq.q: On the staff, the note B sits on
mcq.explanation: B is on the middle line.

mcq.q: Swimming is important because
options: it is a life skill that helps keep you safe near water
mcq.explanation: Swimming helps prevent drowning.

mcq.q: Why do we shower before entering the pool?
mcq.explanation: It removes dirt and sweat.

mcq.q: In the sit-and-slide entry, you should turn
options: to face the wall and hold the edge
mcq.explanation: You hold the edge as you lower yourself in.

mcq.q: Which game uses small sinking toys?
mcq.explanation: Players pick up toys from the pool bottom.

mcq.q: Why is it called the mushroom float?
options: The back at the surface looks like the top of a mushroom
mcq.explanation: The rounded back at the top looks like a mushroom cap.

mcq.q: What helps your body to float?
options: Water pushes up on it and lungs full of air
mcq.explanation: Buoyancy and air in the lungs.

mcq.q: What happens if you lift your head during a glide?
mcq.explanation: Lifting the head lowers the legs.

mcq.q: Indigenous games are
options: traditional games that belong to a people and place
mcq.explanation: They are passed on by playing together.

mcq.q: The crab walk is done
options: on hands and feet with the tummy facing up
mcq.explanation: It is like the crab balance, but moving.

mcq.q: The hare hop is done
options: by hopping forward with both feet like a hare
mcq.explanation: Small quick hops.

mcq.q: Which Kiswahili word means frog?
mcq.explanation: Chura is a frog.

mcq.q: In the hawk and the chicks game, the chicks
options: hold on gently behind the hen
mcq.explanation: Chicks stay in line.

mcq.q: A hare hop suits a rhythm that is
mcq.explanation: Hares hop quickly.

mcq.q: Counting steps and jumps in animal games links to
mcq.explanation: Counting is a maths skill.

mcq.q: To analyse a work of art means to
options: look closely at its parts to understand it
mcq.explanation: Analysing means studying the parts.

mcq.q: Two stars and a wish means
options: two good comments and one suggestion
mcq.explanation: Give two positives and one idea to improve.

mcq.q: Which material can you use to make a portfolio?
mcq.explanation: Manila paper folds easily.

mcq.q: When presenting your artwork, you should hold it
options: by the middle with wet hands
mcq.explanation: Careful handling keeps it clean.

mcq.q: How many verses does the Kenya National Anthem have?
mcq.explanation: The anthem has three verses.

mcq.q: Which of these is a national day on which the anthem is sung?
mcq.explanation: Jamhuri Day is a national holiday.

mcq.q: In a folk song, the chorus
mcq.explanation: The chorus responds to the soloist.

mcq.q: Which is a focus when analysing a team sport performance?
mcq.explanation: Teamwork and safety matter.

short.q: State two ways of playing percussion instruments.
short.answer: Striking and shaking. Scraping is also correct.

short.q: Explain how you decide whether a percussion instrument is melodic or non-melodic.
short.answer: Listen to the sounds. If it plays different notes, high and low, that make a tune, it is melodic. If it gives only a beat or one kind of sound, it is non-melodic.
short.working: 1 mark for listening, 1 mark for melodic meaning, 1 mark for non-melodic meaning.

short.q: Describe the procedure of making charcoal sticks for drawing, from cutting to cooling.
short.answer: Cut dry, straight twigs about the length of a hand. Trim off bark, knots and leaves. Pack the twigs tightly in a tin and close the lid with a small hole. An adult burns the tin in a fire until the smoke stops. Leave the tin closed to cool completely before opening.
short.working: 1 mark each for cutting, trimming, packing, burning by an adult, and cooling.

short.q: State the three commands at the start of a sprint race in order.
short.answer: On your marks, set, go.
short.working: 1 mark for all three, 1 mark for the correct order.

short.q: State three points of good sprinting technique.
short.answer: Eyes look ahead; elbows bent and arms swing back and forth; knees lift high; land on the front of the foot; body leans forward slightly. Any three.

short.q: State what red, white and the shield stand for on the Kenyan flag.
short.answer: Red stands for the blood shed for freedom. White stands for peace and honesty. The shield and spears stand for the defence of freedom.

short.q: Explain what a relay race is and how it teaches teamwork.
short.answer: A relay is a race in which each runner in a team runs a short distance and passes a baton to the next runner. The team wins by working together and passing smoothly.
short.working: 1 mark for team running, 1 mark for the baton, 2 marks for teamwork explanation.

short.q: Describe how to make a chest pass.
short.answer: Hold the ball at chest height with both hands. Look at the partner. Step forward and straighten the arms, turning the thumbs down. The ball goes to the partner's chest.

short.q: Why do we improvise a netball?
short.answer: Some schools do not have enough balls. We can use materials we have, such as string and waste cloth. It lets more learners practise.

short.q: Explain why netball is called a team game.
short.answer: Players must pass to each other to move the ball and score. No player can run with the ball alone.
short.working: 1 mark for passing or cooperation, 1 mark for the explanation.

short.q: Explain how to make a shade of green.
short.answer: Add a small amount of black to green, and more if needed.
short.working: 1 mark for black, 1 mark for adding a little.

short.q: Explain what overlapping is and why it is used in a montage.
short.answer: Overlapping means placing one piece so it partly covers another. It removes gaps and makes the montage look full and joined up.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for the reasons.

short.q: State two ways to keep the working area clean after painting.
short.answer: Wash the brushes and containers, wipe the desk, put the paper in the bin. Any two.

short.q: State the lengths of a crotchet rest and a quaver rest and how to show a rest when clapping.
short.answer: A crotchet rest is one beat of silence and a quaver rest is half a beat of silence. When clapping, we do not clap but keep the beat silently.
short.working: 1 mark for each length, 1 mark for showing the rest.

short.q: Describe three qualities of a good rhythmic pattern.
short.answer: It has variation of note values, repetition of a group of notes and ends on a long note.

short.q: What are the sol-fa syllables for the three notes learned, and which is the lowest?
short.answer: d, r and m. d is the lowest.
short.working: 1 mark for naming, 1 mark for the lowest.

short.q: Why should a short melody end on d?
short.answer: d is the home note. Ending on it makes the melody sound finished.

short.q: Why do we scratch and wet clay before joining pieces?
short.answer: It makes the surface rough and sticky so the pieces hold together and do not fall off when dry.
short.working: 1 mark for scratching, 1 mark for water, 1 mark for the reason.

short.q: What is a side roll?
short.answer: A roll along the mat sideways with the body straight and long like a log.
short.working: 1 mark for sideways roll, 1 mark for the straight body.

short.q: State four safety rules for gymnastics.
short.answer: Use a mat or soft ground; keep the space clear; remove jewellery; tie back long hair; warm up; take turns; stop if there is pain. Any four.

short.q: Why is gymnastics not a race?
short.answer: It is about control and quality of movement, not about speed.
short.working: 1 mark for control, 1 mark for not speed.

short.q: Write what the signs p and f mean.
short.answer: p means soft. f means loud.

short.q: Describe how to learn the East African Community anthem for performance.
short.answer: Listen to it several times, read and discuss the words, clap the rhythm, sing line by line and then sing the whole song together in unison while standing straight and respectful.

short.q: How can you show the mood of a joyful song when singing?
short.answer: Smile, use lively gestures, sing brightly and at a lively tempo.

short.q: Give three responsible ways of using a device for photography.
short.answer: Ask permission before photographing someone; do not photograph in private places; do not share photographs without permission; use it only for the set task. Any three.

short.q: Give four ways to make a clear centre of interest.
short.answer: Decide the subject first; move closer; remove distractions; place the subject in the middle or slightly to the side; keep it sharp; bend to eye level. Any four.

short.q: Name the three joints of a descant recorder and state where the mouthpiece is.
short.answer: Head joint, middle joint and foot joint. The mouthpiece is on the head joint.
short.working: 1 mark for the joints, 1 mark for order or naming all, 1 mark for the mouthpiece.

short.q: Give three ways of storing and handling a recorder safely.
short.answer: Keep it in a bag or case; keep away from heat; do not drop it; twist joints gently; do not bite it. Any three.

short.q: Where do the notes B, A and G sit on the staff?
short.answer: B is on line 3, A is in the space between line 2 and line 3, and G is on line 2.

short.q: Describe the sit-and-slide water entry.
short.answer: Sit on the edge with feet in the water, hands on the edge beside the hips. Turn to face the wall and slide gently into the water holding the edge.

short.q: Explain the difference between the prone float and the supine float.
short.answer: Prone is face down in the water with arms stretched forward. Supine is on the back with the face up and ears in the water.
short.working: 1 mark for each float, 1 mark for the difference.

short.q: Why do we use a streamlined shape when gliding?
short.answer: A long, thin shape slips through the water easily, so you glide further.

short.q: Describe how to do the elephant walk.
short.answer: Bend forward at the waist, clasp hands so that the arms hang like a trunk, and walk slowly with heavy steps, swaying the trunk.

short.q: Explain how animal games help to keep the body healthy.
short.answer: They strengthen muscles, stretch the body, improve balance and coordination and make the heart and lungs stronger.

short.q: What does it mean to appreciate a work of Creative Arts?
short.answer: To notice, understand and value it, giving reasons for what you think.

short.q: What is the difference between a working portfolio and a display portfolio?
short.answer: A working portfolio holds work in progress. A display portfolio holds the best finished works for showing.

short.q: State three values taught by the Kenya National Anthem.
short.answer: Unity, peace, justice, hard work, service, patriotism and thankfulness to God. Any three.

short.q: Explain what sportsmanship means and give two examples.
short.answer: Being fair and kind in sports. Examples: following the rules and shaking hands with the other team.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for each example.

short.q: Describe the steps for painting a picture of one object that shows colour value.
short.answer: Choose an object and place it near a window. Draw the outline lightly. Mix the main colour and paint the object. Add a lighter tone on the lit side and a darker tone on the shadow side. Blend the edges and add a shadow, then let it dry.
short.working: 1 mark for each of five clear steps.

short.q: Describe how to play the note G on the descant recorder and explain how to get a good tone.
short.answer: Hold the recorder with the left hand at the top and the right at the bottom. Cover the thumb hole and holes 1, 2 and 3 with the pads of the left fingers. Put the mouthpiece between the lips and blow gently and steadily with a soft too.
short.working: 1 mark each for holding, thumb hole, three holes, mouthpiece and gentle breath.

short.q: Explain the steps of a full sprint from the start commands to the finish.
short.answer: On your marks: go to the line and take the position. Set: lift the hips slightly and stay still. Go: push hard and swing the arms. Run in your lane with high knees and bent arms. Keep running through the finish line and slow down gradually.
short.working: 1 mark each for marks, set, go, running technique and finishing.
